commercial_projects.title: Sanjo BuildTrack
commercial_projects.description: Daily work tracking for a construction company: who worked on which site, for how many hours, in which crew, and what everyone is owed. Monthly payroll in five currencies with PDF/CSV export, receipt photos stored in S3, QR check-in for crews and an installable PWA in five languages.
commercial_projects.stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, react-i18next, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS S3, Railway, GitHub Actions

commercial_projects.title: Sanjo Tool Tracker
commercial_projects.description: Inventory system that answers at any moment which tool exists, where it is and who has it. Storekeepers issue and return tools by scanning a QR code with a phone; every movement goes into one event log. Includes bookings without overlaps, signed handover PDFs, GPS locations on a map, Telegram and web-push notifications, loss reports and CSV/Excel/PDF exports in Ukrainian, Czech and English.
commercial_projects.stack: React, Node.js, Express, PWA, Leaflet, Telegram Bot API, Web Push, Railway

commercial_projects.title: TaisiyaStyle
commercial_projects.description: Website and online booking for a hairdresser in Prague. Clients book an appointment on the site, the owner manages bookings through a Telegram bot, and a separate worker sends day and hour reminders and asks for reviews after the visit. The API is covered by unit and integration tests.
commercial_projects.stack: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, Telegram Bot API, Railway
